entries.title: Proverbs 5:1
segments: ¶My son, pay attention to my wisdom; Lend your ear to my understanding,

entries.title: Proverbs 5:2
segments: That you may preserve discretion, And your lips may keep knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:3
segments: For the lips of an immoral woman drip honey, And her mouth [is] smoother than oil;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:4
segments: But in the end she is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:5
segments: Her feet go down to death, Her steps lay hold of hell.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:6
segments: Lest you ponder [her] path of life-Her ways are unstable; You do not know [them].

entries.title: Proverbs 5:7
segments: Therefore hear me now, [my] children, And do not depart from the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:8
segments: Remove your way far from her, And do not go near the door of her house,

entries.title: Proverbs 5:9
segments: Lest you give your honor to others, And your years to the cruel [one];

entries.title: Proverbs 5:10
segments: Lest aliens be filled with your wealth, And your labors [go] to the house of a foreigner;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:11
segments: And you mourn at last, When your flesh and your body are consumed,

entries.title: Proverbs 5:12
segments: And say: "How I have hated instruction, And my heart despised correction!

entries.title: Proverbs 5:13
segments: I have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, Nor inclined my ear to those who instructed me!

entries.title: Proverbs 5:14
segments: I was on the verge of total ruin, In the midst of the assembly and congregation."

entries.title: Proverbs 5:15
segments: ¶Drink water from your own cistern, And running water from your own well.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:16
segments: Should your fountains be dispersed abroad, Streams of water in the streets?

entries.title: Proverbs 5:17
segments: Let them be only your own, And not for strangers with you.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:18
segments: Let your fountain be blessed, And rejoice with the wife of your youth.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:19
segments: [As a] loving deer and a graceful doe, Let her breasts satisfy you at all times; And always be enraptured with her love.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:20
segments: For why should you, my son, be enraptured by an immoral woman, And be embraced in the arms of a seductress?

entries.title: Proverbs 5:21
segments: For the ways of man [are] before the eyes of the LORD, And He ponders all his paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:22
segments: His own iniquities entrap the wicked [man], And he is caught in the cords of his sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:23
segments: He shall die for lack of instruction, And in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
